name: Longines
note: Swiss watchmaker, 'a member of Swatch Group Ltd.'; presents the Red Sea Turf Handicap (USD $2.5m) at the Saudi Cup meeting, is official timekeeper at Chantilly/Deauville/Longchamp and sponsors the Prix de Diane Longines and Prix de l'Opera (France Galop partners page), and is a Dubai Racing Club partner.
